culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yoriko Danno who used her shoelace to stack together a lot of 5 yen coins to form a rod. The murder was committed because the victim (Ikuyo Yatani) indirectly killed the murderer's son. Ikuyo Yatani was the pickpocket who stole Yoriko's wallet a year earlier with her car keys in it, which kept her son (who had asthma) stuck in her car to die from suffocation.

motive.zhHans: 谋杀之所以发生，是因为被害人（Ikuyo Yatani）间接害死了犯人的儿子。意外死亡（过去） 地点：Yoriko 的车 被害人：Yoriko 的儿子 死因：窒息（哮喘发作） 犯人：Ikuyo Yatani 过去，她的儿子死在她车子的后座上，因为 Ikuyo 连同她的钱包一起偷走了她的车钥匙。为了复仇，她开始调查那个小偷，并常常出入小偷平日出现的地点。Yoriko 透露，她把那张自己与儿子的合照留在钱包里，是为了让 Ikuyo 知道，她偷走的不只是钱，还偷走了一个孩子的生命。
motive.en: The murder was committed because the victim (Ikuyo Yatani) indirectly killed the murderer's son. Accidental death (Past) Location: Yoriko's car Victim: Yoriko's son Cause of death: Suffocation (Asthma Attack) Culprit: Ikuyo Yatani In the past, her son suffocated in the rear seat of her car because Ikuyo stole her car keys along with her wallet. In a quest of revenge she began researching the thief and hung out in the spots where she usually appeared. Yoriko reveals that she left that photo of herself and her son in her wallet so that Ikuyo would know that she didn’t just steal some money, but that she also stole a child’s life.

method.zhHans: 犯人是 Yoriko Danno，她用鞋带把大量 5 日元硬币串拢在一起，做成一根棍状物。为了复仇，她开始调查那个小偷，并常常出入小偷平日出现的地点。之后揭晓，Tohei Benzaki 其实是波本（Bourbon）的伪装，而贝尔摩德伪装成他怀孕的妻子，把他从这个案子里摘了出去。
method.en: The culprit is Yoriko Danno who used her shoelace to stack together a lot of 5 yen coins to form a rod. In a quest of revenge she began researching the thief and hung out in the spots where she usually appeared. Afterwards, it is revealed that Tohei Benzaki is actually Bourbon in disguise and Vermouth disguised herself as his pregnant wife to get him out of the case.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yoriko Danno，她用鞋带把大量 5 日元硬币串拢在一起，做成一根棍状物。谋杀之所以发生，是因为被害人（Ikuyo Yatani）间接害死了犯人的儿子。Ikuyo Yatani 就是一年前偷走 Yoriko 钱包的小偷，钱包里还有她的车钥匙，这使她那个患有哮喘的儿子被困在她的车里，最终窒息而死。意外死亡（过去） 地点：Yoriko 的车

summary.en: Conan, Professor Agasa and the rest of the Detective Boys goes to a shrine ground to view Cherry blossom. There Conan meets up with Jodie to tell her that Scar Akai was Bourbon in disguise to test the FBI's reaction and find out if Akai is really dead. He futher tells her that Bourbon calls himself Tooru Amuro and works at Poirot under the detective agency.

suspects: Yoriko Danno, Tohei Benzaki, and Shigemori Sakamaki
